messages:
olivia: Heads-up — nightly perf alert from ci-bot for the small-batch path. p99 latency ~35% above baseline this run. Link: https://internal/bench/213456 (logs + raw output there).

ci-bot: [ALERT] perf/nightly-small-batch failed: small_batch_latency_p99 = 312ms (threshold 230ms). Job: nightly-bench/2026-03-17-02:00.

sam: Oof. Any obvious PR hits between the last good commit and this one? tagging @nina for recent runtime changes.

nina: I pushed a small KV-cache eviction tweak yesterday (PR 7683) that changed default max_prefix_cache_size. Might impact small-batch steady state. I can try a quick reproduce locally.

olivia: If you can repro, please paste the repro command and a small flamegraph/pprof. Quick repro command (nightly runner):
```
./bench/run_small_batch.sh --model=gpt-4f-small --seq=512 --batch=4 --commit=<sha>
```
Also grab the debug trace: /debug/traces/<job-id>.zip from the bench job artifacts.

lee: I'll pull the failing job and run the profiler now. Steps I use to fetch artifacts:
```
ci-agent fetch nightly-bench/2026-03-17-02:00 --artifacts > artifacts.tar.gz
tar -xzvf artifacts.tar.gz
pprof --svg artifacts/bench/profile.pb > profile.svg
```
Posting profile.svg shortly.

nina: Quick local run against PR 7683 reproduces the regression on A100 (seq=512, batch=4). Baseline p99=235ms, PR=315ms. Looks like extra mem copies in kv cache refill path.

sam: Can you bisect the commit in that PR (which commit introduced the change)? if it's a config tweak maybe revert is fastest.

nina: Will open a revert PR for the eviction tweak. I'll also add a targeted micro-benchmark and a fix if needed. Opening revert: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7742 (WIP). ETA ~4h to CI + canary.

olivia: Thanks — assigning owner to @nina. Once revert lands, let's run a canary on dedicated-smallpool (low-traffic) and then roll forward with a stricter regression test. Please paste canary job link when ready.

lee: profile.svg uploaded to the bench artifacts; added short notes pointing to kv_cache::refill hotspot.

olivia: Great sleuthing. Marking this thread as the handoff reference. :thumbsup:
